items.title: Capri Global Capital Limited
items.description: CGCL has informed the Exchange regarding the revised outcome of the Board Meeting held on November 28, 2026, wherein the Board approved the proposal for making a further investment of ₹200 crore in the equity share capital of Capri Global Housing Finance Limited ( CGHFL ), a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company, by subscribing to the equity shares offered by CGHFL on a rights basis. In this regard, it is clarified that, in the original intimation filed with the Stock Exchanges on November 28, 2026, at 03:20 P.M. (IST), the indicative timeline for completion of the acquisition was inadvertently mentioned as March 31, 2026, instead of March 31, 2027, under Point No. 6 of Annexure A. Accordingly, the revised Annexure A is being submitted to rectify the aforesaid inadvertent typographical error. All other disclosures contained in the original intimation remain unchanged. |SUBJECT: General Updates

items.title: Pritika Engineering Components Limited
items.description: Dear Sir/ Madam, Pursuant to regulation 29 and other applicable regulations, if any, of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 we inform you that a meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company will be held on Friday, the 4th December, 2026 to consider and discuss inter-alia the following along with other matters:1. To consider Migration of Listing/Trading of Equity Shares of the Company from SME Platform (EMERGE) of National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) to Main Board of NSE and to transact other incidental and ancillary matters. 2. To consider and approve Postal Ballot Notice.  3. To consider and fix  Cut-off Date  for the purpose of e-voting for Postal Ballot and decide  e- voting schedule.4. To appoint Scrutinizer to conduct Postal Ballot and e-voting Process.5. To approve  Calendar of Events for Postal Ballot.6. Any other item with the permission of Chair.  We request you to take the above on your records.  A copy of this intimation is also being made available on the company s website at www.pritikaengineering.com |Meeting Date: 04-Dec-2026
